# Molle Hatch Panel Installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove rear hatch components, drill holes, cut plastic grid, insert hex bolts with serrated nuts, then snap panels back in place. [t230]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the first aid pouch from the rear hatch.
2. Unscrew two screws located underneath where the first aid pouch sits.
3. Pop loose covers on the handle and unscrew the two bolts holding it in place.
4. Pry off the main plastic interior panel covering the hatch surface.
5. Position the Molle panel to desired location and mark drilling spots.
6. Drill holes through the back of the plastic panel, avoiding existing clips if possible.
7. Cut sections of the internal plastic grid with a knife blade for flush mounting.
8. [Partial] Insert hex bolts from the rear side along with washers.
9. [Partial] Secure each bolt on the front using an 11mm serrated nut (serrated side against plastic).
10. Screw in another serrated nut above it, facing upwards to hold the panel tight.
11. Align and position the Molle panel over the bolts so they line up with holes.
12. Slide washers onto the bolt ends from behind the hatch surface.
13. Tighten each assembly using wing nuts until secure.
14. Snap the plastic interior panel back into place on the rear hatch.
15. Re-attach the handle screws and re-insert two small screws for the first aid pouch mount.

_Procedure reported by [t230]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-heps-designs-molle-hatch-panel.7330/>_

## Tools

- Phillips screw driver [t230]
- Flat head screwdriver or trim pry tool [t230]
- 11mm socket and wrench [t230]
- Drill with 1/4 inch drill bit [t230]
- Knife or blade [t230]

## Parts

- 12 serrated nuts [t230]
- [Partial] 6 bolts, hex [t230]
- 6 washers [t230]
- 6 wing nuts [t230]
- Molle Hatch Panel [t230]

## Tips & gotchas

- Ensure the serrated side of the nut faces against the plastic for better grip. [t230]
- [Partial] Check that bolts line up correctly before sliding on washers and tightening. [t230]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Drilling into or too close to existing clips on the back of the hatch panel. [t230]
